scope: Synthetic CPU primitive references; no native/shared API, model weights, or BF16 quality claim.

interpretation.gdn: q/k/v are post-convolution in physical GGUF head order; upstream normalizes q/k and scales q once by 1/sqrt(Dk).
interpretation.conv: taps [C,K] oldest first; history [(K-1)*d,C] raw, oldest first; SiLU after convolution.
interpretation.gain: HC gain is effective 1+w; GDN norm gain is direct. Fixtures use exactly recoverable effective gains.
interpretation.state: State tensors are owned copies; reset means zeroing both recurrent state and raw conv history.
